entries.label: Morning brief
entries.text:
Today's session — Walk 15 minutes at a comfortable pace:

Today's 15-minute walk is a perfect way to ease into movement without pressure. Let it be a reset for your body and mind, not a test. Just show up and take those steps at your own comfortable pace—you've got this.
